results.product_description: Luna G3 BPAP System  Model/Catalog Number: LG3800-30VT  Product Description: The Luna G3 BPAP System is a Bi-level PAP (Bi-level Positive Airway Pressure) device designed for the treatment of adult Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA).
results.reason_for_recall: The configured IPAP value is recorded and transmitted instead of the actual delivered inspiratory pressure when Targeted VT is enabled.
